slice: A7 process wiring slice 1: Slack recovery approval path (prepare_proposal)
author: Claude Code (Opus 5.5)
decision: user 2026-11-20: approval wait opens only on an explicit request-approval command; first slice = approval path
flow: ACK: request-approval <event ref|this> <exact 64-hex plan hash>; anything else rejected
relay: plan hash -> exactly one live plan-recovery request of the same user; same channel/thread/event else uniform UNAVAILABLE
WF06 ledger.open (approvers, retention, original result checks unchanged); fixed reply texts, no exception text
ledger.page (time transitions only) -> A7-2 outbox enqueue every 5s; at most one delivery per relay tick; failures contained
ingress SlackRouter: /slack/events + /slack/interactivity on one TLS listener; button receiver uses the signing secret only
recovery-approval.json absent or disabled -> unchanged behaviour; invalid or ungranted approvers -> start/check-config fail
default observe port always fails (observation_not_connected): no approval wait can open in a real deployment

mutations: default observe port made to succeed

known_behaviour: no approval wait opens in a real deployment until a verified PR-path current-state reader is wired
after approval nothing revalidates yet; the approval expires and an expiry notice is sent
approver must be the plan requester (existing WF06 slack_plan_source restriction)
execute_command scope not wired; its buttons are rejected as approval_scope_unavailable
changed approval policy needs the explicit replace_policy transition (not wired); start is refused
Slack DB lock contention on a button press returns 503; Slack does not retry; the same press is idempotent
a queued approval request may still be sent before a later status notice; late presses are recorded as expired by the ledger
not_in_scope: revalidation after approval and WF07 hand-off
execute_command approvals with the restart coordinator
WF10 renderer mount of recovery-approval.json and Slack Interactivity Request URL
no_external_actions: no cluster, GitHub write, deploy, Slack, incident drill, Terraform, paid model call
